```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Young Americans entering the workforce can stay on their parents' plans today.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Insurers can no longer refuse to cover kids with pre-existing medical conditions today.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Insurance companies will no longer be able to arbitrarily cap and cancel coverage today.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Insurance companies will no longer be able to charge women more simply because of their gender today.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"People with private insurance are getting preventive services like cancer screenings, annual well-woman visits, and FDA-approved contraception with no out-of-pocket costs today.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"New Offices of Minority Health have been established.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"State Medicaid programs are being helped to fund home and community-based services.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Small businesses are receiving tax credits to help them cover their workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Businesses and families are receiving rebates from insurers who overcharged them.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Working families will finally have the security of knowing they won't lose health care or be forced into bankruptcy if a family member gets sick or loses their job soon.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Insurance companies will no longer be able to deny coverage based on pre-existing conditions soon.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Medicaid will cover more working families soon.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Those who don't get insurance at work will be able to shop in new exchanges and will be eligible for new tax credits soon.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"All Americans will have access to health care as a result of these changes.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"30 million citizens will finally gain health insurance.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
